# MapQuest

> > MapQuest is a comprehensive mapping and navigation platform offering interactive maps, real-time directions, travel inspiration, and developer APIs for location-based services.

MapQuest provides both consumer-facing mapping and navigation tools through its mobile app and web platform, as well as a robust developer API suite for geocoding, directions, search, and static mapping. The platform serves travelers, adventurers, and developers seeking location intelligence and routing solutions.

## Key Topics

- Geocoding API
- Directions API
- Search API
- Icons API
- Static Map API
- Real-time traffic
- GPS navigation
- Multi-stop routing
- City guides
- Travel inspiration
- Landmarks
- Nearby cities
- Developer platform
- Mapping services
- Adventure travel

## Developer APIs

- [Geocoding API | MapQuest Developer](https://developer.mapquest.com): MapQuest developer platform offering Geocoding, Directions, Search, and Icons APIs for location-based applications.
- [Geocoding API | MapQuest Developer](http://business.mapquest.com): MapQuest developer platform offering Geocoding, Directions, Search, and Icons APIs.

## Mobile & Navigation

- [Discover the new MapQuest.](https://hello.mapquest.com/mobile): MapQuest mobile app with navigation, real-time traffic, GPS, and multi-stop routing features for on-the-go travelers.

## City Maps & Guides

- [United States Map of Cities - MapQuest](https://www.mapquest.com/us/united-states-282934758): United States map with cities, national parks, and tourist attractions guide.
- [New York, NY Map & Directions - MapQuest](https://www.mapquest.com/us/new-york/new-york-ny-282040974): New York City map with directions, landmarks, and local business information.
- [Chicago, IL Map & Directions - MapQuest](https://www.mapquest.com/us/illinois/chicago-il-282039507): Chicago map with directions, city guide, and nearby cities travel information.
- [Los Angeles, CA Map & Directions - MapQuest](https://www.mapquest.com/us/california/los-angeles-ca-282039899): Los Angeles map with directions, attractions, and travel information guide.

## Travel & Adventure

- [MapQuest Travel - Inspiration For Your Adventure](https://www.mapquest.com/travel): Travel inspiration and adventure guides featuring destinations like Congo River and Pan American Highway.

## Optional

- [MapQuest Careers](https://hello.mapquest.com/careers): System1 and MapQuest careers page with job openings and company culture information.
- [Discover the new MapQuest.](https://hello.mapquest.com/terms-of-use): MapQuest terms of use and legal agreements for services and user rights.
- [Discover the new MapQuest.](https://hello.mapquest.com/attributions): Third-party attributions and open-source licenses for MapQuest and Open Street Map.
